crossRefs.note: I decreed, and search has been made, and it was found that this city has made insurrection against kings in the past…
crossRefs.keyword: Give ye, etc. Chal. Make a decree

translations.web: Make a decree now to cause these men to cease, and that this city not be built, until a decree is made by me.
translations.bsb: Now, therefore, issue an order for these men to stop, so that this city will not be rebuilt until I so order.
translations.kjv: Give ye now commandment to cause these men to cease, and that this city be not builded, until another commandment shall be given from me.
translations.asv: Make ye now a decree to cause these men to cease, and that this city be not builded, until a decree shall be made by me.
